name: Explain
body: Every suggestion shows its reason in one or two sentences, drawn from the theory engine.

name: Key
body: A chord outside your key is labeled borrowed or outside. It is never corrected.

name: Note
body: A note outside the current scale is marked, but never removed.

name: Accept
body: A suggestion changes your song only after you accept it.

name: Count
body: A progression holds up to sixteen bars. Longer pieces are split into sections.
